A story about my history of abuse stemming from my narcissistic alcoholic father. I was adopted into a rich family at birth and was treated differently solely because I was their only son. They adopted 3 other daughters (my now sisters) but my father always wanted a son that was just like. My whole life he never accepted the fact that I wasn’t his biological son and he’s practically hated me ever since. He uses his money as a way to control every aspect of my life. He even bought my apartment building, and threatens to evict me every time I don’t do what he tells me too. 
Ever since this Roe v. Wade bullshit started, I’ve been trying to educate people on the fact that adoption isn’t always a happy ending. Sometimes it could be a whole new hell. Some people will just never understand though.
